description: This file defines the CustomerController class for the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It manages the customer view component, retrieving unselectable customer IDs via a service trait and preparing the Vue component for rendering.

classes.name: CustomerController
classes.description: Controller for managing customer view in the OrangeHRM Time plugin, extending AbstractVueController and utilizing CustomerServiceTrait.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the customer list Vue component by fetching unselectable customer IDs and adding them as a property.
